correctness.rationale: The source's controlled fifth state equation contains \((1-u_2(t))\beta_{hv}e^{-\mu_v\tau}I_h(t-\tau)S_v(t-\tau)\). Direct first-order product expansion necessarily preserves the survival factor, contains both delayed variations \(\widetilde I_h(t-\tau)S_v(t-\tau)\) and \(I_h(t-\tau)\widetilde S_v(t-\tau)\), and gives the control term \(-\rho_2(t)I_h(t-\tau)S_v(t-\tau)\). The published Eq. (26) instead omits the survival factor, duplicates the \(\widetilde I_h\) term, and evaluates the \(\rho_2\) term at current states. In the adjoint pairing, substituting \(s=t+\tau\) forces advanced coefficients \(\lambda_5(t+\tau)(1-u_2(t+\tau))\beta_{hv}e^{-\mu_v\tau}S_v(t)\) and its \(I_h(t)\) counterpart on \([0,T-\tau]\), incompatible with the printed Eq. (32). The same first variation forces the corrected delayed-state contribution in the \(u_2\) stationarity formula. Therefore the printed Theorem 9 system is not the first-order system of Eq. (23) for general positive delay.
